newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sept 1 grain stocks highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sept 1 grain stocks highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA estimates of September 1 grain stocks, with year-ago below (1,000 bu):
USDA said old-crop corn stored in all positions on September 1, 1996 is estimated to be down 73 percent from September 1, 1995, and is the lowest ending stocks level since 1976.

On-farm corn stocks on September 1 are down 73 percent from a year ago, and off-farm corn stocks are down 72 percent. The indicated disappearance from all positions for the June-August quarter is 1.29 billion bushels, 30 percent below the disappearance from the same quarter a year ago, USDA said.
Soybean stocks on Sept 1, 1996 are down 45 percent from the year-ago level. On-farm stocks are down 43 percent from a year ago, and off-farm stocks are off 46 percent.
September 1 wheat stocks are down eight percent from Sept 1, 1995. USDA said this is the lowest September 1 stocks level since the reference date was changed in the 1986-87 marketing year.

On-farm wheat stocks on September 1 are up 11 percent from a year ago, but the off-farm level is down 21 percent. All wheat disappearance for the first quarter of the 1996-97 marketing year totals 934 million bushels, up 16 percent from the same period last year, USDA said.
